guidance.heading: 2026 Guidance
section: Management is revising and increasing the midpoint of its full-year guidance and establishing fourth quarter guidance for diluted EPS, diluted FFOPS, per Nareit, and diluted FFOPS, as adjusted for comparability, as follows:

Reconciliation of Diluted EPS to FFOPS, per Nareit,and As Adjusted for Comparability | Quarter Ending December 31, 2026 | Year Ending December 31, 2026
Low | High | Low | High
Diluted EPS | 0.29 | 0.31 | 1.43 | 1.45
Real estate-related depreciation and amortization | 0.37 | 0.37 | 1.48 | 1.48
Gain on sales of real estate | — | — | (0.14) | (0.14)
Diluted FFOPS, Nareit definition | 0.66 | 0.68 | 2.77 | 2.79
Demolition costs on nonrecurring improvements | 0.02 | 0.02 | 0.02 | 0.02
Diluted FFOPS, as adjusted for comparability | 0.68 | 0.70 | 2.79 | 2.81

The Company detailed its initial full year guidance, with supporting assumptions, in a separate press release issued February 5, 2026; that release can be found in the ‘News & Events – Press Releases’ section of COPT Defense’s Investors website: https://investors.copt.com/news-events/press-releases
